   *Objective*: Determine if a specific data point was used to train the AI model, potentially revealing sensitive information.

   *Methodology*:
   - *Step 1*: Train a shadow model using a dataset similar to the target AI system's training data.

   *Potential Outcome*: By successfully evading the AI system's defenses, an attacker can cause the system to make incorrect decisions, leading to potential real-world consequences depending on the AI system's application (e.g., misrouting vehicles in an autonomous driving system).
